"""Wire-format utilities only; no collective state machine."""
import struct,zlib
MASK=(1<<24)-1
NAMES=('allreduce','reduce','broadcast','barrier','allgather','reducescatter')
def checksum(data):
    total=sum(struct.unpack('!10H',data))
    while total>>16:total=(total&65535)+(total>>16)
    return (~total)&65535
def seal(frame):
    """Seal a complete frame: IPv4 header checksum then the reflected ICRC."""
    frame=bytearray(frame)
    frame[24:26]=b'\0\0';frame[24:26]=struct.pack('!H',checksum(frame[14:34]))
    crc=bytearray(b'\xff'*8+frame[14:-4])
    crc[9]=255;crc[16]=255;crc[18:20]=b'\xff\xff';crc[34:36]=b'\xff\xff';crc[40]=255
    frame[-4:]=struct.pack('<I',zlib.crc32(crc))
    return bytes(frame)
_PREFIX={}
def _prefix(rank,size,ack,outgoing):
    """Cached Ethernet/IPv4/UDP header plus the ICRC state of the fixed part."""
    key=(rank,size,ack,outgoing)
    hit=_PREFIX.get(key)
    if hit is not None:return hit
    hostmac=bytes((2,0,0,0,0,rank+1));swmac=bytes((2,1,0,0,0,rank+1))
    hostip=bytes((10,0,0,rank+1));swip=bytes((10,0,0,101+rank))
    if outgoing:sm,dm,si,di,q=swmac,hostmac,swip,hostip,0x100+rank
    else:sm,dm,si,di,q=hostmac,swmac,hostip,swip,0x200+rank
    bodylen=4 if ack else size
    udp=struct.pack('!HHHH',4791,4791,8+12+bodylen+4,0)
    ip=struct.pack('!BBHHHBBH4s4s',0x45,0,20+len(udp)+12+bodylen+4,0x1111,0x4000,64,17,0,si,di)
    head=bytearray(dm+sm+b'\x08\x00'+ip+udp)
    head[24:26]=b'\0\0';head[24:26]=struct.pack('!H',checksum(bytes(head[14:34])))
    bth=struct.pack('!BBHI',0x11 if ack else 4,0,65535,q)
    crc=bytearray(b'\xff'*8+bytes(head[14:])+bth)
    crc[9]=255;crc[16]=255;crc[18:20]=b'\xff\xff';crc[34:36]=b'\xff\xff';crc[40]=255
    hit=(bytes(head),bth,zlib.crc32(bytes(crc)))
    _PREFIX[key]=hit
    return hit
def packet(rank,physical,payload=b'',ack=False,outgoing=False):
    """Build one canonical RoCEv2 frame (Ethernet/IPv4/UDP/BTH/body/ICRC)."""
    head,bth,state=_prefix(rank,len(payload),ack,outgoing)
    if ack:
        body=struct.pack('!I',0x1f000000|((physical+1)&MASK))
        apsn=struct.pack('!I',physical&MASK)
    else:
        body=payload
        apsn=struct.pack('!I',(physical&MASK)|0x80000000)
    return head+bth+apsn+body+struct.pack('<I',zlib.crc32(apsn+body,state))
def payload(seed,p,rank,words):
    return struct.pack('!%dI'%words,*((seed+0x9e3779b9*(p+1)+0x85ebca6b*(rank+1)+0xc2b2ae35*(j+1))&0xffffffff for j in range(words)))
def emissions(case):
    """Expand public input shorthand; performs no simulated switch decisions."""
    base=case['start'];kind=case['primitive'];k=case['segments'];d=case['words']
    for op in case['events']:
        name=op['op']
        if name=='data':
            r=op['rank']
            for i in range(op.get('count',1)):
                p=op['p']+i*op.get('step',1)
                body=struct.pack('!%dI'%len(op['values']),*op['values']) if 'values' in op else payload(op.get('seed',0),p,r,d)
                f=bytearray(packet(r,(base+p)&MASK,body))
                for offset,value in op.get('xor',[]):f[offset]^=value
                yield ('wire',r,bytes(f))
        elif name=='ack':yield ('wire',op['rank'],packet(op['rank'],(base+op['upto']-1)&MASK,ack=True))
        elif name=='wire':yield ('wire',op['rank'],bytes.fromhex(op['hex']))
        elif name=='train':
            end=op['p']+op['count']
            for lo in range(op['p'],end,op['width']):
                hi=min(end,lo+op['width'])
                for r in op['ranks']:
                    if kind=='broadcast' and r!=case['root']:continue
                    seq=range(hi-1,lo-1,-1) if op.get('reverse',False) else range(lo,hi)
                    for p in seq:yield ('wire',r,packet(r,(base+p)&MASK,payload(op.get('seed',0),p,r,d)))
                for r in range(4):
                    n=3*hi if kind=='allgather' else max(0,min(k//4,hi-r*(k//4))) if kind=='reducescatter' else hi if (kind!='reduce' or r==case['root']) and (kind!='broadcast' or r!=case['root']) else 0
                    yield ('wire',r,packet(r,(base+n-1)&MASK,ack=True))
        else:yield (name,op.get('rank',op.get('n',op.get('tag'))),None)
